name: 雨の精霊・NePoLaBoの雨女

boost.name: 雨勢增強
effect: Your attack gains +X Power (X is the number of NePoLaBo cards in your boost area).
Relay: When this card is sealed from your boost area as a cost, at the start of your next turn, you may return it from your sealed area to your boost area.
description: 獅白ぼたん的雨女迷因化為雨の精霊——暴雨讓她的攻擊力道增強。boost 區每有一張 NePoLaBo 卡，攻擊 +1 Power；四張齊聚時雨勢達到最強。被作為 seal 代價封存後，下一回合飛回 boost 區，如同雲雨循環永不散去。

name: 水の精霊・NePoLaBoの水神

boost.name: 水之湧泉
effect: When you Strike, draw X cards (X is the number of NePoLaBo cards in your boost area).
Relay: When this card is sealed from your boost area as a cost, at the start of your next turn, you may return it from your sealed area to your boost area.
description: 桃鈴ねね的水神 Hydrohomie 迷因化為水の精霊——如同她直播時狂喝水補給，每次 Strike 時湧出泉水，boost 區每有一張 NePoLaBo 卡抽 1 張牌。被 seal 後飛回 boost 區，如同她的水桶永遠裝滿、源源不絕。

name: 雪の精霊・NePoLaBoの雪女

boost.name: 雪之結界
effect: When you Strike, gain +X Armor (X is the number of NePoLaBo cards in your boost area).
Relay: When this card is sealed from your boost area as a cost, at the start of your next turn, you may return it from your sealed area to your boost area.
description: 雪花ラミィ的雪女設定化為雪の精霊——冰雪凍結成護盾，每次 Strike 時結界累積 Armor，boost 區每有一張 NePoLaBo 卡 +1 Armor，如同雪之壁壘層層加厚。被 seal 後飛回 boost 區，如紛飛的雪永不停止，雪女的身影總會再次降臨。

name: 晴の精霊・NePoLaBoの100℃

boost.name: 高溫加速
effect: Your attack gains +X Speed (X is the number of NePoLaBo cards in your boost area).
Relay: When this card is sealed from your boost area as a cost, at the start of your next turn, you may return it from your sealed area to your boost area.
HIT: Gain Advantage (you take the next turn, regardless of who initiated the Strike).
description: 尾丸ポルカ的「1 Polka = 100℃」化為晴の精霊——沸騰的太陽讓攻擊加速。boost 區每有一張 NePoLaBo 卡，攻擊 +1 Speed；座長 100℃ 的高溫熱力讓行動永遠快人一步。被 seal 後飛回 boost 區，如同太陽無論如何都會再次升起。
